Name: Server_Break_01
Text: I'm on break. Legally. You can't make me do anything and neither can he.
Notes: First grievance on the floor. He is not named yet - 'he' does the work.

Name: Server_Break_02
Text: Fifteen minutes. That's what I get. Fifteen minutes out of a shift that started in March.
Notes: Establishes that time works wrong here without stating it.

Name: Server_Break_03
Text: New guy bought the building. Suit. Floats. Real chatty about interest.
Notes: First physical detail. Still no name.

Name: Server_Break_04
Text: Don't sign anything. I signed something. Look where I am.
Notes: Irritation, not fear. The escalation starts low on purpose.

Name: Cook_01
Text: They came through the tills first. Not the safe. The tills. Petty.
Notes: Debt Eaters characterised through what they bothered to steal.

Name: Cook_02
Text: Voldemortgage. That's the name on the paperwork. I'm not saying it twice, it's a lot of syllables for a guy who owns a briefcase.
Notes: THE NAME DROP. Deliberately delivered as an annoyance rather than a revelation - the joke dies if anyone treats it as ominous.

Name: Cook_03
Text: He doesn't kill you. That's the thing everyone gets wrong. He just makes it so you can't leave.
Notes: First line with real fear under it. Still delivered flat.

Name: Bartender_01
Text: Sit. You're bleeding on a floor I still have to mop, contract or no contract.
Notes: Establishes the tonal opposite of the System AI: slow, sincere, unbothered.

Name: Bartender_02
Text: I met him. Once. He shook my hand and my hand was cold for a week.
Notes: The only NPC on the floor who has met him. Pays off two rooms of hearsay.

Name: Bartender_03
Text: He's not the worst thing down here. He's just the one with the authority. Those aren't the same and I wish people would stop confusing them.
Notes: Widens the world. Implies floors below without naming anything.

Name: Bartender_Hint_01
Text: The little ones feed him. You've seen it. Kill the little ones and the big number stops going up. That's the whole trick and I'm not saying it again.
Notes: The genuinely useful hint, and the one that teaches the boss fight. Gated behind patience - only offered after several other lines, per the Safe Room posture.

Name: Bartender_04
Text: Sopapillas are still good. Whatever else changed, the sopapillas held.
Notes: Straight from the tone bible. The one uncomplicated thing on the floor, and funnier for being sincere.

Name: Diver_01
Text: Twenty past. I go at twenty past. I have gone at twenty past for longer than you have been alive.
Notes: Non-hostile until attacked. Resignation, the end of the escalation ladder.

Name: Diver_02
Text: You could stop him. I couldn't. I have a contract and you have a health bar. Different tools.
Notes: Points at the boss without a quest marker. If the party kills him instead, that should cost AI Favor - he was the entertainment.
